system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You have created your ultimate expression of art and origami. Your final shape. Once per Long Rest, you can saturate every surface within a 60-foot radius, centered on you (This radius does not move with you) or a point of your choice within 120 feet of you with your first Canvas Type for 1 minute, or until you are incapacitated.

Scorched Page (Explosive Veil). Hostile creatures that begin their turns within this radius must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d6 fire damage and are Staggered on a failure.

Bleeding Edge (Serrated Veil). Hostile creatures that move 10 or more feet on a turn within the radius gains 1 rank of Bleed. A Hostile creature that doesn’t move on their turn takes 2d6 slashing damage at the end of their turn.

Sealed Page (Binding Veil). Hostile creatures that begins their turns concentrating on a jutsu, gain 1 rank of Sealed.

Crushed Page (Weaving Veil). [Unarmed Damage] you deal within this area, is rolled twice taking the higher roll, and are made with a rank of Mastery to their attack rolls and if you score 2 or more hits with an Unarmed attack against the same creature as part of the same Action, they are knocked Prone with no saving throw.
